summary: Build a clean, premium, corporate, mobile-responsive lead-generation website for PKC Urban Capital (Pune, India) using Navy (#0B1C2D) + Gold (#C6A75E) with simple, honest investor messaging (no exaggerated claims), positioned as “Authorized Channel Partner – Commercial Real Estate”, including property listings with filters, ROI calculator, lead form, and Call/WhatsApp CTAs (WhatsApp/Call: +91 9657092665) and contact email pkcurbancapital@gmail.com.
architectural_notes: Mobile-responsive layout optimized for lead generation and conversions (clear CTAs, WhatsApp contact points).
Featured properties should support client-side filtering by location, budget, and property type.
Use updated brand palette across the site: Primary Background #0B1C2D, Gold Accent #C6A75E, Heading Text #F5F5F5, Sub Text #B8C0CC.
Site-wide copy should be simple, honest, and avoid exaggerated/unsupported claims; position PKC Urban Capital as “Authorized Channel Partner – Commercial Real Estate”.
All Call/WhatsApp CTAs and displayed contact details must use +91 9657092665 (replace +91 9658092665 wherever present).

Replace/remove any default Hinjewadi demo listing and allow custom commercial project listing entries with editable fields: Location, Carpet Area, Price, Highlights, and a configurable Contact Button; keep styling consistent with the Navy (#0B1C2D) + Gold (#C6A75E) premium theme.
Add and display contact email pkcurbancapital@gmail.com in appropriate contact areas (header/footer/contact section and/or forms).
known_issues: Incorrect contact number used in CTAs/content (+91 9658092665); must be updated to +91 9657092665 site-wide.
Adding/displaying email may be blocked by current platform/account limitation (email features disabled unless upgraded).

existing_features.title: Create a mobile-responsive, premium dark-themed website for “PKC Urban Capital” with a dark slate background (#0f172a), gold accent highlights, luxury/corporate/investor-focused visual style, bold typography for headings, and a clean modern layout used consistently across all sections.

Implement the Hero section with the exact headline and subheadline provided and two primary CTAs: “View Investment Options” and “Get Private Consultation”. CTAs must scroll/navigate to the Featured Investment Properties section and Lead Capture Form section respectively.

Implement an About section that positions PKC Urban Capital as a strategic commercial investment advisory firm and clearly presents the four highlight points: builder-direct inventory, strong negotiation support, ROI-focused consulting, and end-to-end documentation support.

Implement a Featured Investment Properties section that displays a list of commercial investment properties and supports filtering by Location, Budget, and Property Type. Each property card must show: Carpet Area, Price, Expected Rent, ROI %, Possession Status, and a WhatsApp “Get Best Price” button.

Implement a “Why Invest in Pune” section that includes the provided points: IT Hub Growth, Metro Connectivity, High Rental Demand, and Commercial Appreciation, written in a confident, premium, investor-focused tone.
Implement an Investor Calculator section with inputs for Property Price and Expected Monthly Rent and an ROI Output that updates when inputs change.

Implement a Testimonials section with multiple testimonial cards suitable for an investor-focused commercial real estate advisory brand (content can be sample testimonials if no real testimonials are provided).

Implement a Lead Capture Form section optimized for lead generation with fields: Name, Phone, Budget, Property Type, and Investment or Self Use. Provide clear validation and a success state after submission.
Add a floating WhatsApp contact button fixed to the bottom-right of the viewport across the site that opens WhatsApp chat using a configurable number and a prefilled investor-focused message.
Ensure all user-facing text across the site is in English and matches a confident, premium, investor-focused tone.

Add static sample data for properties that reflects the specified Pune areas (Wakad, Baner, Balewadi, Hinjewadi, Pimple Saudagar) and the property types (offices, showrooms, retail shops, high ROI assets) so filters and cards are functional without external integrations.

Add generated brand visuals as static assets and integrate them into the UI (e.g., navbar/hero): a PKC Urban Capital wordmark and a subtle dark hero background texture consistent with a premium commercial real estate brand.
Update the global theme color tokens to match the provided brand palette: Primary Background #0B1C2D, Gold Accent #C6A75E, Heading Text #F5F5F5, Sub Text #B8C0CC.
Replace section- and component-level hardcoded hex colors with theme tokens (or the new palette values) so that the new brand palette is applied consistently across the entire UI.

Update site-wide copy to use the positioning “Authorized Channel Partner – Commercial Real Estate” and remove exaggerated/overpromising language so the tone is clean, premium, corporate, and honest across all sections.
Remove the Testimonials section from the website experience so no fake or sample testimonials are shown anywhere on the site.
Configure all WhatsApp CTAs to use the phone number +91 9658092665, including the floating WhatsApp button and property-card WhatsApp actions.
Add a prominent click-to-call CTA using +91 9658092665 and ensure contact details shown in the header/footer match this number; keep the design mobile-optimized.

Update the centralized contact configuration so the site-wide phone/WhatsApp number is +91 9657092665 (and WhatsApp format 919657092665), and ensure all Call/WhatsApp CTAs and displayed contact details use this updated number.
Remove the default Hinjewadi demo project(s) from the website’s featured listings so no prefilled “Hinjewadi demo” property/project is shown by default.

Update the Featured listings UI to render commercial projects from the backend (instead of the current hardcoded demo property list) and display the required fields on each card: Location, Carpet Area, Price, Highlights, and a Contact Button.

Provide an admin-only UI to manage (add/edit/delete) commercial project listings with editable fields: Location, Carpet Area, Price, Highlights, and Contact Button; only show this UI when the signed-in identity is authorized as admin.
Keep the featured listings layout premium and consistent with the existing Navy & Gold theme, including the new Highlights and Contact Button elements.

Update the WhatsApp link generation so the default WhatsApp CTA uses a clean, minimal URL (no prefilled message query string), while still supporting an optional prefilled message when explicitly requested.
Update all WhatsApp CTA entry points (including the floating WhatsApp button and any card-level WhatsApp actions that use the default message) to use the new clean default WhatsApp link behavior.

Add Hero section with specified headline/subheadline and CTAs: View Investment Options + Get Private Consultation
Add About section positioning PKC Urban Capital as commercial investment advisory highlighting builder-direct inventory, negotiation support, ROI consulting, and documentation support

Add 'Why Invest in Pune' section covering IT hub growth, metro connectivity, high rental demand, and commercial appreciation
Add Investor Calculator section: simple ROI calculator using property price and expected monthly rent to output ROI
Add Lead Capture Form with fields: name, phone, budget, property type, and investment vs self use
Add floating WhatsApp button (bottom right) for quick contact/lead capture
Backend: add a Motoko data model and API to store and retrieve submitted leads from the Lead Capture Form, including timestamp and the exact field values submitted.
Update brand positioning and site-wide copy to use “Authorized Channel Partner – Commercial Real Estate” and keep messaging simple, honest, and free of exaggerated claims
Add a prominent Call button and configure WhatsApp CTAs to use +91 9658092665 across the site (mobile-optimized click-to-call and WhatsApp deep link)

Remove default Hinjewadi demo project and support custom commercial project listings with editable fields (Location, Carpet Area, Price, Highlights, Contact Button) while keeping premium Navy & Gold layout

Add backend support for storing and serving custom commercial project listings with editable fields: Location, Carpet Area, Price, Highlights, and Contact Button; support admin-only create/update/delete and public read/list endpoints.
Add contact email pkcurbancapital@gmail.com to the website (e.g., header/footer/contact section and/or forms as appropriate)
